name: primes-ro-workflow
description: Standalone shop workflow portal for tracking repair orders (ROs) through Primes Auto Service — Kanban board, archive, history, shared shop login. Runs on a shop PC (Node + SQLite) or on Cloudflare Workers + D1.

scripts.cf:secrets: wrangler secret put SHOP_USERNAME && wrangler secret put SHOP_PASSWORD

DB.description: D1 database for repair orders, history and sessions. Created automatically.

SHOP_USERNAME.description: The shared shop username everyone will sign in with (e.g. shop).

SHOP_PASSWORD.description: The shared shop password. Pick something long; it is stored encrypted and never shown again.
